researchConsole.title: AI research team
researchConsole.subtitle: Your agents gather real, sourced data, live

team.title: Team
team.empty: Waiting for the agents to start…

subtitle.running: Our assistants look up real market data and check every figure.
subtitle.done: Every figure is sourced and verified.

trust.title: {{count}} verified sources
trust.subtitle: Every figure links to a real source. Nothing is made up.

planning.0: We are splitting the work between our assistants: research, writing, verification.
planning.1: Every section gets its own researcher before it is written.
planning.2: We are reading your project to know which data to look for.

searching.0: Our assistants are searching the web for real figures about your market.
searching.1: Every figure found is kept together with the link to its source.
searching.2: We look for recent data, specific to your geographic area.

writing.0: We are writing the section from the data found — nothing is invented.
writing.1: Figures are carried over as they are, with their year and scope.
writing.2: A well-sourced section takes a moment to write.

verifying.0: We are checking every figure against the source it came from.
verifying.1: A figure without a source does not stay in your document.
verifying.2: Verification is what separates a reliable document from a plausible text.

finalizing.0: We are assembling the sections and laying out your document.
finalizing.1: Just a moment longer: we are ordering the figures and tables.
finalizing.2: One last pass before handing it back to you.

done.0: Your document is ready, and every figure links back to its source.
done.1: You can now read it through and adjust whatever you want.
done.2: Everything is saved: you will find this document in your project.
